scope: 22 H-positive and 12 B-query-positive points among 162 changed probes (union of IDs); exact source-side ODOL LOD point-face tests, no engine/build; not a visual diagnosis.
interpretation_limits: P is a scalar plane per cell; F is per-cell-corner NW/NE/SW/SE data. Reported margins are conservative maxima over up to four incident supports, not a single globally continuous surface.

The model-surface hit test uses B staged 0WZD source transforms and hash-verified compiled ODOL roadway/visible LOD geometry; the deployed OPRW transforms were not read back from the engine in this task.
A point hit proves projected face coverage at that coordinate, not a rendered pixel or material identity; bbox-only object matches are explicitly distinguished from face hits.

The temporal depth metric is GetWaterDepth at H+0.01 or B+0.01 and correlates with fake surface; the B query is a height discriminator in the H world, not a second B-world run. No wave maximum is inferred.
